summary: The proof is complete and correct. The affine-coordinate reduction is valid; all forced-empty and ambient-realizability claims follow with the stated strict and weak boundary conventions; every table entry agrees with the interval J∩H ⊆ G ⊆ J∪H and G ≠ 0; the midpoint incidence argument is exact; the sharpness construction covers every allowed triple, including all interval-feasibility cases, and yields admissible two-dimensional polytopes; the union identity and convexity claim correctly handle unrestricted coordinates and the impossible empty type; and the singleton classification is exhaustive.
